description: One message by Message-ID: headers, in_reply_to/references, decoded body (default the author's own words: quoted replies and attributions, forwarded or Outlook-quoted mail, inline patches, diffstats and signature removed; full_text=true for everything), attachments [{index, filename, content_type, size}], has_patch. quotes: each comes back with own_words (in their own text, whitespace-normalized) and in_message (anywhere); include_body=false returns only the verdicts. Never raw MIME: get_attachment, get_raw_message (RFC 822 source). Cite https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

full_text.description: Whole decoded text, quotes and signature included (default false: own words)

quotes.description: Up to 20 quotes to check; under 12 characters is too_short

name: get_message
